body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/tests.md (entry dated 2026-09-22).

In the Linux whole-tree run at 82a113a this parallel subtest failed with `work_final_check_test.go:193: exit=2 ... {"errorCode":"ADAPTER_FAILED","state":"ERROR"}` — three adapter receipts (snapshot, details, verify) PASSED and the fourth produced no receipt at all. Rerun in the same container with `go test -count=3 -run '^TestWorkFinalCheckCaptureBinding$' ./cmd/corvint` it PASSES three times (18.6s), and it did not fail in the earlier full-suite run, so it depends on concurrent load rather than on the platform. Done looks like: the failure path records why the fourth adapter invocation failed (stderr/signal on the receipt) so a future occurrence is diagnosable, and the subtest no longer fails under `-p 1` whole-tree load.
